description.fallback: There was once an ancient tribe, who held incredible power. These people lived far longer than humans could, but were unable to step into sunlight. Primitive humans worshiped them as gods.

outro.fallback: JoJo proclaims that this was his plan from the very beginning, lying to make Kars mad.
